t: A prayer for whoever leads and whoever calls
a: الإِمَامُ ضَامِنٌ وَالْمُؤَذِّنُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَرْشِدِ الأَئِمَّةَ وَاغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤَذِّنِينَ
p: Al-imāmu ḍāminun wa-l-muʾadhdhinu muʾtaman. Allāhumma arshidi-l-aʾimmata wa-ghfir li-l-muʾadhdhinīn
m: The imam carries a responsibility and the caller holds a trust. O Allah, guide the imams and forgive the callers.
